eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 无账号 · 单命令

headline.zh:
把整个仓库
塞进 coding agent 的上下文
headline.en:
Feed your whole repo
into your coding agent

sub.zh: 按缓存感知顺序把 1000+ 文件切片塞进百万 token 长上下文窗口，一次 MCP 往返拿到答案——绕过 ChatGPT 的 40 文件上限，单次查询成本低于旗舰模型，数据不离本机；主模型不可用时一条命令切到备用，成本底线不破。
sub.en: Shard 1000+ files in cache-aware order into a 1M-token long-context window so coding agents fetch the whole repo in one MCP round-trip — past ChatGPT's 40-file cap, below flagship-model per-query cost, with data staying on your machine. If the primary model is down, switch to a backup with one command and the cost floor holds.

body.zh: 不再被 40 文件上限卡死——整个仓库一次塞进上下文，agent 看全貌再答。
body.en: Stop hitting the 40-file wall — the whole repo goes into context in one shot so the agent sees the full picture before answering.

body.zh: 缓存感知的摄入顺序：依赖清单、README、类型定义先入，之后只重摄入改动文件，不重算整个仓库；尊重 .gitignore，生成物不占上下文。
body.en: A cache-aware ingest order: deps, README and type defs go in first, then only changed files are re-ingested — never the whole repo twice. It honors .gitignore, so generated files never waste the context window.

body.zh: 一条命令切到备用长上下文模型，成本底线不破；偶发限流自动重试，失败给清晰报错而非直接崩溃。
body.en: Switch to a backup long-context model with one command and the cost floor holds; transient rate-limits retry automatically and a failure returns a clear error instead of a crash.

body.zh: 百万 token 长上下文模型撑起全仓库查询，单次成本低于旗舰模型；附成本对比仪表盘，数字始终诚实。
body.en: A 1M-token long-context model backs a whole-repo query at a fraction of a flagship model's per-query cost — with a cost-delta dashboard whose numbers stay honest.

headline.zh: 让 agent 看见整个仓库
headline.en: Let your agent see the whole repo

sub.zh: 一条命令装好本地 MCP 后端，绕过文件上限，主模型不可用还能切备用。
sub.en: One command installs the local MCP backend — past the file cap, with a backup model one switch away.

tag.zh: 本地 · MIT · 一次往返 · 数据不离本机
tag.en: Local · MIT · One round-trip · Data stays on your machine
